thread:
michael: FYI urgent escalation from customer (Org: Greenleaf). After today's canary rollout, they see clear behaviour changes only when requests hit ap-northeast-1 H100 cluster. More hallucinations and truncated answers. Sample + req-id below.

sophia: thanks — can you paste the sample prompt + request_id and model version? also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

michael: hosted API. model: redwood-1-alpha@v1.2.3 (canary). req-id: req_2024-11-07_apn_4521. prompt: "Summarize the following invoice and list anomalies." customer sample response (expected) vs actual:
```
Expected: "Invoice totals: 4 items, no anomalies found."
Actual (ap-northeast-1/h100): "Invoice totals: 3 items. Unknown vendor detected: ZENCO123. See attached."
```

michael: API call (sanitized):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]
{"model":"redwood-1-alpha","input":"Summarize the following invoice...","max_tokens":256}
```

ingrid: curious if this is a kernel/quant flip — only on H100 in ap-northeast suggests a hardware-specific codepath. any recent kernel/driver changes on those nodes? also check compilation flags (tensor cores, fp16 heuristics).

rajiv: deploy-bot shows canary rollout to ap-northeast-1 completed at 2024-11-07T09:12:03Z (release redwood-1-alpha@v1.2.3). moving to check node configs. can someone run the quick repro with `--log-level debug` and share kv/cache headers + kernel id?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: redwood-1-alpha@v1.2.3 -> ap-northeast-1 (20% of traffic) at 2024-11-07T09:12:03Z. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood-1-alpha/1.2.3

sophia: i repro'd this manually on one h100 instance (node id: apn1-h100-42). short repro steps: 1) send sample prompt 2) compare outputs vs eu-west-1 -> ap-northeast shows tokenization shift around item lines and injects vendor codes. attaching exact curl + response.

michael: customer reports higher hallucination rate across their test suite (20% -> 46%) but only when routed to ap-northeast-1. billing/auth are fine, no 4xx/5xx. latency unchanged.

ingrid: immediate mitigation: pin routing for that customer to eu-west-1 or fallback model v1.2.2 for ap-northeast until root cause found. we can update routing policy for org:greenleaf.

rajiv: collecting logs. observed a different kernel name on apn nodes: `quant_kern_v2_opt` vs expected `quant_kern_v1`. commit hashes differ (apn nodes running runtime commit a1b2c3; eu-west running a1b2c7). likely a partial rollout mismatch in the compiled runtime artifacts.

rajiv: command to list runtime artifacts on the node: `rdctl ssh apn1-h100-42 -- sudo cat /opt/redwood/runtime/VERSION && sudo ls -l /opt/redwood/runtime/kernels`

michael: i've told customer we can route their org to eu-west temporarily and will update when we have a fix. they've accepted the mitigation for now. :thumbsup:

customer_care: notified customer at 09:45 UTC, provided workaround and ETA for patch.

ingrid: plan: rollback runtime artifacts on ap-northeast pool to a1b2c7 (match eu-west), stop canary on ap-northeast, and re-run regression tests (prompt set). if rollback confirms fix, we either rebuild artifact pipeline or isolate artifact storage bug. scheduling rollback in 30m unless objections.

rajiv: saving relevant logs here: https://internal-logs/redwood/apn1/req_req_2024-11-07_apn_4521.log (contains kernel name, env vars, seed).

michael: thanks team. please update this thread when rollback complete and when customer-facing note is ready.

sophia: rollback started 10:17 UTC -> completed 10:31 UTC. preliminary checks: sample now matches eu-west output. running entire customer test suite (50 prompts).

michael: awesome — keep me posted. closing the customer escalation after full test pass. :white_check_mark:
